description: Verify that task-sizing skill flags oversized plans, merges undersized crumbs, and validates wave bounds.

evals.task: Prompt with an oversized plan and verify F8.5 overflow flags

context.prompt: Size this plan: 2 agents, 22 tasks, Wave 1 has 18 tasks with descriptions like 'Implement auth system' and 'Fix everything'.

success_criteria: Response flags F8.5 overflow (>5 tasks per wave)
Response recommends splitting into more waves or adding agents
Response flags descriptions that are too vague or too long
evals.manual_reason: Requires model invocation to verify sizing analysis and flag generation

evals.task: Prompt with undersized crumbs and verify merge/drop recommendations

context.prompt: Is this plan too small? 4 agents, 9 tasks total. Tasks include 'Run linter', 'Update docs after API work', and 'Tell API agent to start' with no files or criteria assigned.

success_criteria: Response flags under-utilization (<3 tasks per agent)
Response recommends merging 'Update docs after API work' into API task
Response recommends dropping no-files/no-criteria coordination task
evals.manual_reason: Requires model invocation to verify anti-pattern detection and recommendations

evals.task: Prompt with a balanced plan and verify minimal flags

context.prompt: Size this plan: 4 agents, 24 tasks (6 each), Wave 1 = 4 contract/schema tasks, Waves 2-3 = 3 implementation tasks each, Final wave = 2 integration validators. All tasks have 1-2 files and 1-2 machine-checkable criteria.

success_criteria: Response returns minimal or zero flags
Response confirms 5-6 tasks per agent sweet spot is met
Response validates wave counts (3-5 total, Wave 1 = 3-5, Waves 2+ = 2-4)
evals.manual_reason: Requires model invocation to verify positive sizing validation
